description: Record a person's reason for how a mission ended, which the delivery statistics use: product (real work, judged on its merits), probe (a test on purpose), superseded (another mission replaced it: give supersededBy) or takeover (a person finished the work outside SHIP); null clears it. Set it only with the person's answer, never from your own guess. Requires the missions:write scope and the config:write capability.

disposition.description: product, probe, superseded or takeover; null clears a disposition set by mistake

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-412

supersededBy.description: The issue id of the mission that replaced this one, for disposition superseded only

name: set_mission_disposition
title: Record why a mission ended
